changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0078. Dashboard widget visibility is its own permission category so a role can hide a widget without losing the underlying module permission. Index review: no new indexes; inserts use UX_Permissions_Code and PK_RolePermissions. Performance note: the catalog write is a fixed set of rows.

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM app.RolePermissions WHERE PermissionId IN (SELECT Id FROM app.Permissions WHERE Code LIKE N'DASHBOARD_WIDGET_%'); DELETE FROM app.Permissions WHERE Code LIKE N'DASHBOARD_WIDGET_%';
